reference: Amador et al., Veh. Commun. 34 (2022) 100454, Table 3 (ETSI CBF); Artery/Veins/OMNeT++; 5 runs x 30 DENMs per density
deviations: Receiver sensitivity/noise not stated: derived so free-space range = 778 m.
Vehicle speeds not stated (SUMO defaults): cars only, 100-130 km/h assumed.
CAM rate not stated: modelled as our background beacon load at 10 Hz with DCC.
One DENM per run from a moving detecting vehicle, not 30 DENMs at 1 Hz from a stationary one; statistics pooled over seeds instead.
Epoch-based engine at 10 ms: every transmission in an epoch is concurrent; 802.11p backoff is abstracted (sim/mac.py), not simulated per 13 us slot.
Mobility: our fallback generator (or SUMO if present), not the paper's SUMO network.
